value.rationale: This is a complete sharp finite-size phase diagram at the five-by-five odd two-dimensional torus for the source directional constraint. The exact open K=17,...,21 sectors are settled, every recurrent state is characterized by a natural plaquette-free criterion, and finite class sizes are determined independently.
